tieu_de: Biography of the Living Buddha Te Gong
noi_dung:
Biography

LIVING BUDDHA JI KONG

Living Buddha JI KONG was a person of the Southern Song dynasty (1150-1209), originally from Thien Thai district, Zhejiang province, surnamed Li, named Tu Duyen, who took refuge at the temple. Linh An in West Lake, Hangzhou, his dharma name is Dao Te. Because he often uses tricks to pretend to be crazy to save lives, people often jokingly call him Te Dien. The Living Buddha's body is the Golden Body of the Arhat, the Golden Dragon Venerable, deeply understanding samadhi, that is, right concentration, calming the mind to meditate in order to achieve a state of carefree intuition in order to thoroughly understand and realize Buddha Dharma, meaning: "All dharmas inherently appear because of the mind" (All dharmas exist only in the mind). And directly cultivating the Buddha's mind without relying on means, it should be said: "Cultivate the mind without cultivating the mouth to become a living Buddha" (Cultivate the mind without cultivating mouth, the monks and nuns at that time only "precepts the mouth" and not "precepts the mind", so the Living Buddha spoke a warning voice to help them become enlightened. He has great supernatural powers, saves humanity, defends danger, and often mocks those who are good and specialize in evil deeds to make them enlightened.But especially for the evildoers who did not know how to repent, he attacked them without hesitation, making people very happy, so people called him a holy monk and revered him as the Living Buddha. It was certainly not by accident.

The Living Buddha used to live in Tinh Tu Pagoda, the pagoda caught fire, needed wood for restoration, the Living Buddha traveled to Nghiem Lang, used his robe to cover the mountains, uprooted the trees and let them float to Hangzhou. He went back to inform the monks in the pagoda that "the wood is in the Huong Tich well." The monks ran out to see and it was indeed true. There are many strange stories like that passed down in generations.

Around the year Gia Dinh (1209), he passed away and was buried at Ho Bao Tower. At the moment of his death, he composed a song:

Song written

Six decades later lang ta
The East wall beats the West wall
The metal collects it back
Y old water keeps the sky wall.

Sings that

Sixty years of my life are shattered
The east wall pushes against the west wall
Gathering forever still returned empty-handed
The water immediately became a cloudy blue sky.

After passing away, a monk met the Living Buddha at the foot of the Luc Hoa tower. In the letter sent back, there was attached a poem

as follows:

Poetry

Memorial of the past is the first to see off
Chi Kim do Giac bone cold
Only the face of the unconscious mind
The old Thien Thai ran away for a while.

Translation

Remembering the past is in front of your eyes to block flying arrows
Why are your bones and flesh cold now
The face asks who can remember
Thien Thai I'm happy again this.

So the Bodhisattva promised to return to earth. The Buddha lived his entire life to save and transform, walking around the human world to provoke anger and laughter, without worrying or shyness, cultivating "the practice of asceticism, practicing the Bodhisattva way, wearing a ragged robe, enjoying the worldly life. His torn shoes were soaked in mud, he held a fan in his hand, he was not afraid of high or low, the top of his head was shining brightly, the wind did not beat him, the rain did not bury him, so did he still need a conical hat? Vacuum, cold and heat are not violated, why do you need clothes? Don't beg for alms because you're not hungry or thirsty. Lazy and dignified because of the lack of fur, humorous and laughing, making good relationships widely, not hiding from the world, looking for a voice to save suffering, hundreds of families vying for respect, boundless compassion, wonderful virtue, no monk who has retreated to live in seclusion in the deep mountains and valleys can compare. Every word and every word is like a sharp thorn and taunting knife, leaving home from the tolerant intellectual region of Ngu Nhac, so in the next life any Buddha who considers himself noble will avoid talking about it.Therefore, a high level of holy monks was lost and could not be revealed. Fortunately, my Buddha was compassionate and did not complain, did not get depressed, lived beyond worldly attachments, demonstrated meditation everywhere, practiced Buddhism with full of joyful nuances, so the great name "Zen Master" resonated everywhere. The great spirit of the world transformed into positive merits of entering the world, is truly a shining example for those today who study Buddhism and practice the Way, so when life gave the holy name "Living Buddha" it is very reasonable.

Now facing the end of the Dharma, sentient beings are burned by the fire of desire, immersed in the sea of suffering, the Living Buddha is determined to save people, so the miraculous Dharma of the past is revealed again, vowing to reincarnate again, descending to the Holy Path. Guide the original spirit Duong Sinh to visit the underworld, collect authentic evidence to warn the world. From there, the secrets of hell were revealed, creating magnetic boats to save sentient beings. Those who are blessed to be bathed in the rain of Dharma will forever stay away from evil paths. How great, the great work has been completed, remaining forever, remembering the great virtue.

WRITING

Confronting and singing, returning to the world of deluded disciples
One smile on the flower, the original part of the wonderful method of Zen
Life is like a play, acting with ecstasy and transforming into one's mind
All dharmas return to the mind, transform into hell and paradise.

PROCEEDING

Bringing religion to life, calling people to awakening Holding flowers and smiling, the door of esoteric magical meditation A life drama, playing the role of God and Buddha Entering the mind of all dharmas, walking around hell and paradise.

tieu_de: Mr. Tam's Words Before Reading Paradise Travel
noi_dung:
HE EIGHT'S WORDS

BEFORE READING TRAVEL IN PARADISE

Yesterday, a long day, you also learned a lot and there were people who were still frustrated in their hearts for not being truly open and understanding. Why not fully understood? Because people's desires are too many, but the actions in front of them seem jarring, some are right and some are not, unclear, so it becomes infected with resentment. So today is the full moon day of the ninth month, we gather here, clear our hearts and aim upward, let go of all our separate thoughts, negative emotions, or whatever things are inside us, so that we can respond to the teachings and show us what heaven is? How to go? On the occasion of this full moon day, our minds have the opportunity, have the good fate to gather in surprise at this moment to read the book Paradise Travel, together with those who have practiced in practice and have a sense of resolution so that your level can understand more and grasp it to go and forget all the worldly things to return to the eternal and immortal true situation in which there is real, the human world is confused, criticized, attached, sad, pitiful, when we understand heaven, then where is heaven?At that time you will see that your mind is heaven, extremely happy. Are you lacking food? Lack of clothes? Nothing is missing! Why is there still a dispute? Why is there still confusion? That's why wise people call deluded people stupid! What is stupid? If you have wealth you don't know how to enjoy it, if you have a mind you don't know how to use it, if you have a clear mind that doesn't know how to go there to exploit it, that's why you crave heaven and are fed up with hell. If you dispute with them without insight, you can't fight. If you want to return to lightness, it's already involved, how can you return to lightness? Therefore, those who practice Vo Vi close themselves to meditation to focus their radiant light and it will increase its vibrations faster so that it blends with the upper world, then it will understand how the principle energy from above has been working, millions and billions of times faster than us, but we ourselves are vague and frustrated with a few words. That is the darkness of the individual, we should understand and trace our origin to being extremely active and never slacking, but always rich in forgiveness and love. Where is forgiveness? People are clear-headed, vibrating that infinitely evolved force brings clarity;Only when the sun is extremely evolved will it shine everywhere, the moon will be extremely evolved, gathering all the gentle upward trends to create a golden moonlight for everyone to enjoy on the mid-autumn night. Therefore, on the occasion of Mid-Autumn Festival, we have the moon and the sun in our hearts, we have the vibration to pave the middle path of evolution on the great path. We must take advantage of our own available abilities and evolve to enjoy the furnace of clear light that is being distributed into the consciousness of all living beings, bringing immense happiness. You are not lacking anything. There's no shortage of food, no shortage of clothing, just worrying about how much money makes you feel lacking, gossip feels lacking, selfishness feels lacking! No wonder you're not missing anything! Having too much to eat and too much to wear, while living in paradise, the human world manifests itself as hell because the mind is picky, the mind is not open, the mind is still comparing, cultivating the path, wanting this, wanting that, wanting that, but not returning to our own true enlightenment to enjoy the clear light that we can build for it to evolve to infinity. So look at your face and know your heart, you must remember to correct your mind, your face will be beautiful, your soul will be clear.

On this occasion when I come here, I also gather all the classics to look up and worship those above who contributed to building the book Paradise Travel. We are the ones who re-read and analyze for everyone to clearly understand what the truth is? Who gave it to us? In fact, we have to go to get there! Therefore, we must give up all mental karma to have a chance to get to that place.

HEADING

How good! Infinity conceived countless primordial spirits, at an obscure age descended to mortal life to take on human life. Initially, the nature of heaven was pure and gentle, not forgetting its roots, when living in this world, when dying, it returned to heaven. But because the earthly world's air is decreasing day by day, the impurity is increasing, the bright spiritual nature gradually disappears, and for a long time one forgets the old village as the origin of the Heavenly world, is infatuated with the ocean of desires and the river of love, accepting the earthly world as the new homeland of joy. Therefore, as we sink deeper and deeper, our sinful actions accumulate, causing our bodies to be filled with crimes. Therefore, we cannot help but establish hell and clear the waters to restore our original Heavenly nature. To overcome delusion, the Mother Goddess once incarnated as Avalokitesvara and the Saints, looking for a cry for relief from suffering and depending on the conditions.

Today with the advancement of science and technology, people rely more and more on their talent to attempt to take over the destiny of Heaven, so we must regret that morality is overlooked and worry about restoring the ancient dharma. When our mind is open, loving and constructive, the appearance of the dharma is different, everyone who sees it loves it, everyone wants to meet that part. Those of you who practice Vo Vi are aiming to reach that only then will you be able to lead the world and practice the Dharma.

You know one part of the tone, but if you look again, our body also has three tones. Upper, middle and lower levels all awaken the soul to the clear realm, and clearly see how we should cultivate, use our inner consciousness to cultivate so that the Three Thanhs return to the upper, middle and lower realms as one. At that time, it is called leisure, living in this world is no longer a mortal, not holding on to conflicts, knowing clearly the value of love filled with light and light, brought into our souls, leading our souls to wander freely in the realms, that is the spirit of a cultivator. We learn a lot, creating water to fill our ears, mouth, and nose, but the mind must wash itself, so self-cultivation and self-advancement are like that. Self-cultivation means washing one's true heart and keeping it calm. It is a large, spacious and light warehouse to contain the light of the good Father. The more we look at the truth of the clear light, the more courageous we become. Where is the courage? By understanding it, knowing it, comprehending it, practicing in it, we can clearly see the power within us. Every time you understand everything in life, you will have enough courage to stand in the face of all obstacles.As for the precepts, it's the same, when you have decanted the bar, you are in harmony with the above, you see clear courage. I am the bar I return to myself. I return to an eternal scene that is indestructible and never changes. When our souls are lightened, what do you think? Is there no reason for me to jump in? I still had to hold the bar, but to save my life, I still jumped in. When I jump in, I'm still the bar. Therefore, some living beings can practice and some cannot. We see that the person who achieves purity is the one who cultivates and cultivates himself. People who have not yet achieved purity find practicing very difficult and arduous. It attracts, it demands, it makes the soul restless and unstable. Today we open up, only by opening up our own essence can we clearly see that we already have the clear light, have the essence, look back and see that we are indestructible, never destroyed. If you look inside, you will see eternity protected and clearly evolving. The aggressions of the world, the excitements of the world are all temporary.That's why God has given you this dharma, try it among your family and friends, sitting there meditating and it will come to tease you and tickle you, but you just patiently worry about reciting Buddha's name and then your arms get tired and you have to go. That's the story of life. Life is all about arguing, but then it gets boring, then it has to give up. So why do you learn the course in patience? Patience is letting go, letting go of everything, each color has its own color, there is no more confusion, and the mind becomes clearer and clearer day by day, more and more clearly, seeing more clearly the wonderful things of the whole universe that can only be discerned in a single moment in us. Your mind is concentrated and you see, every color must return to emptiness, every color will return to emptiness, everything must return to oneness. We love our brothers and sisters too. What is the standard of love? You have to rely on oneness to love.

Sometimes you come here to study, meet the Teacher, meet heaven, meet the Father, see the origin, see the unity of spirituality, there is only one, when you see everything is one, then where is the heavenly plan? It lies with you. Since you have evolved to infinity, you will clearly see that the one origin disperses all things, all things return to one origin, do you see clearly? We have been scattered into the wild, giving birth to each of us with a different nature. Now we are united, returning to being one. Humanity is us, we are humanity. The universe is me, I am the universe, must I return to one source? Then when you know that everything will return to one origin, everything will be in purity and concentration immediately. There's no need to worry about your neighbors! What is there to worry about about the person in front of you? Why worry about the person behind you? The mysterious scene in our inner consciousness, we do not embrace, do not open, and do not see clearly, just create chaos. Looking outward and creating motivation, how can we evolve? Therefore, we have enjoyed many clear lights and blessings that the Immortals and Buddhas have illuminated for us. From the moment we pray and practice, but we do not receive it because our minds are still impure.The mind still thinks about this person, that person, that person but does not think about itself, does not return to itself to repent and repent. I made myself dark. That sin is the heaviest sin, the sin of destruction. So you have the method of Soul Reflection, close your eyes to see the light of the other side, not the light of this side. Your essence is over there, not here. So Soul Insight from darkness, from darkness it opens to greatness, to the universe, you see enough moon and stars, many directions of development from outside to inside, becoming more and more clear. Seeing that we are living in happiness, from space to time, everything is in harmony with us and we are in harmony with everything, living in happiness. So that stream of great compassion, you can't receive it too much, but through words you will feel that openness. Where was it created? Is it based on the book? Are not! But based on spirituality, your mind also enjoys that purity. That is the epitome of great compassion, you must understand this! Then, little by little, we move forward, expand, we exploit and take advantage of our own existing abilities to get back on the right path of self-cultivation and self-advancement.We have been walking around paradise for a few days now, we see that everyone above is free of obstacles, their minds are calm and we explain to sentient beings and advise them that they must let go of all karma in order to have a chance to evolve to that realm. If we still hold on to disputes, we create heavy mental karma. If it's heavy, it will sink. Before your eyes, you have also learned that if you put something heavy in the water, it will sink, but if you drop something light into the water, it will float across the river and cross the river as if it were nothing. So those of you who have gone to heaven, crossed the river, don't need to go by boat anymore, but your will has been opened, the heavens have been opened and you can go wherever you want. The same principle, but whether your mind and conduct are willing to practice, willing to progress, willing to build or not to avoid pollution by foreign invaders, our mind must always be directed upward and liberated in a peaceful, balanced, and open way. So today we start again, going one more step to contemplate how much the clear light is above us, everyone will receive the clear light later, mind and body will be at peace.

tieu_de: Chapter 14: Walking to the Donghua Palace for the Third Time to Visit the Primordial Flower of Living Beings
noi_dung:
PART FOURTEEN

TOURING THE THIRD FLOWER PALACE

Visiting the Primordial Spirit of Living Beings

Living Buddha Te Gong Christmas day, November 13, year of the Goat (1979)

Poetry

Bach cha can first in the front section
Flying the first step to become an immortal
Deep in the mountains and six trees to open the new leaf
The hustle and bustle of cultivating the body and enjoying the pleasures heaven.

Translation

The magic stick in front of you is too high
One step to become a fairy, try to fly
The green tree in the mountains has just sprouted buds
Noisily cultivating in the market to enjoy the joy of heaven. (1)

Buddhist worship: People everywhere have warm feelings, when they go to a restaurant, the owner warmly invites them, pours tea, gives them a handkerchief, goes to the vegetable market to buy vegetables, the sellers also warmly welcome them, regardless of whether they are evil or good people, they all treat each other with the same friendliness, without ever thinking wrong or wrong, everywhere the feelings are truly passionate. If

some people say: "They are for money, not for people, how can that feeling be good?" Ha ha, the world is all about valuing money over people which is too "realistic", because living beings think too much. Merchants provide us with vegetables and rice to keep us warm and full, but we also have to pay them to maintain their activities. So it is very natural to support heaven in a very selfless way, implementing the principle of mutual assistance and mutual generation, which is very "realistic" and "essential", so how can we complain. Just by keeping our duties and responsibilities right, we can change our means of dressing, living, moving, and nourishing ourselves so that life can be happy, that is one thing, it is all, everything

which is one. That's why it is said: "With one, all things can be accomplished" (achieve the best of all things). The Great Tao also transforms from one into a thousand different things. If it can develop the strength of all people to its fullest extent, it will be able to provide all the necessary needs and bring all operations back to the Great Tao, demonstrating the infinite power of the Tao.

This kind of warm love is also the Tao of love. Although it is said to be an emotionless great path, love can give birth and nurture heaven and earth, creation and all things, so it can be seen It is clear that not only is heaven and earth not indifferent, but on the contrary, the emotions of heaven and earth are extremely impartial and vast, considering all living beings as one entity, like a mother carrying a fetus, always worried and watching.

Duong Sinh: If that's the case, how can you still speak?

Praying to Buddha: Isn't the little air you breathe provided by heaven? Regardless of whether there are good people or evil people, God gives oxygen equally, as well as water to drink and land to walk on, God also gives to everyone fully and fairly. The reason why heaven and earth love humanity is because the feelings of heaven and earth for humans are so deep, humans have absorbed the grace of heaven and earth in an easy and familiar way, so we must thank heaven and earth, follow the trajectory outlined by heaven and earth, sentient beings can naturally live forever in peace under the embrace of heaven and earth, life and death are one, both receive mercy from heaven and earth, then the birth and death of sentient beings is not natural and not worthy of optimism. Why?

Today, teachers and students only write the book Journey to Paradise with the purpose of clearing the confused minds of sentient beings, so that even though they live in this world, they can enjoy the pleasures of paradise, so that they can revive the spiritual spirit of ancient Sages, build a peaceful life for all future generations, and bring eternal happiness to humanity who is currently helpless and lost.

Duong Sinh: Dear Master, each of your teachings is extremely wonderful. I believe that if people listen to you preach, they will definitely have the feeling of drinking nectar and bathing in the rain of Buddha's Dharma.

Buddhist worship: We should not talk much during the journey, quickly get on the lotus platform to visit Dong Hoa Palace again.

Duong Sinh: Dear teacher, I have ascended to the lotus platform. I respectfully invite you to depart.

Buddhist worship: ...Having arrived at Dong Hoa Palace, let us quickly go first and bow before the Emperor.

Duong Sinh: Please obey. Congratulations to the Emperor Donghua, today I will follow you to visit your palace again, respectfully asking for your guidance to guide sentient beings under the sky.

Di Quan: From ancient times until now, although there has been talk about heaven and hell, it is all about wandering in nothingness, there is no one who is determined to thoroughly understand the direction, and is determined to reach heaven. Before and after, everything hindered progress, so it was pushed to the dangerous and deadly step, because everyone broke down in the middle of the road and could not reach the final goal, causing some people with a heart for religion to lose all faith. That's why the blue sky has compassion, revealing to the world the heavenly landscapes, making people with a heart for religion not restless, delirious, eager to go up and will definitely reach there.

The reason having to write a book called Paradise Travel is not an easy task. It can be compared to the blue mountains and blue waters. We also have to go through the wind and rain to temper the fundamentals of sentient beings. For those with profound abilities, only the branches and leaves shake but the roots remain steadfast, because in order to cultivate a great path, one must first have a strong and indomitable will. We must have a spirit like the sun, the moon and all the stars, no matter how many storms, winds and rains we encounter, we will still not deviate from our orbit. Therefore, the planet will be eternal and immortal, and people who practice the Way must also have this ambition. Today you two are back here again, I would like to guide you two to visit the garden of Nguyen Linh flowers and grass.

Duong Sinh: Thank you, Emperor Quan, last time I only saw the Nguyen Linh flowers and trees of some monks in this hall, today I hope to see more.

Di Quan: Very good, please follow me.

Duong Sinh: Those are all the original spirit seedlings of this hall's disciples, why are they gathered into such a group?

Di Quan: Because the sentient beings born in each locality are different, so when entering the teachings and cultivating the religion and Guan Di and getting married, naturally those trees were moved and planted in the same garden, so the ancients said: "Things of the same species gather together". Sentient beings with predestined relationships, even though they are thousands of miles apart, can still gather together, become husband and wife or soul mates, like friends scattered across the four corners of the sky, but when times come, fate brings them together and they have the opportunity to gather together under the roof of Thanh Hien Duong. The primordial spirits in heaven are exactly the same, trees and flowers gather together in one garden.

Duong Sinh: Those trees were originally the primordial spirit trees of Thanh Hien Duong's disciples, blooming in a variety of colors, with many cracks on the branches, I don't understand why?

Dijun: Those trees are the original spirits of sentient beings. Sentient beings enter the holy gate. Although they are ready and determined to cultivate the path, they are like a person sitting in a chariot who is hastily pulling at the reins, wanting to make the horse run as fast as possible, so they often violate the rules of practice. Now that I have reached middle age, I hope to correct the mistakes symbolized by those cracks, so that the Dharma tree can bloom and bear fruit.

Duong Sinh: These trees are also the original spiritual trees of the Thanh Hien Duong Dharma friends, their branches are lush, their green leaves are smooth, but why are the tops cut off, sap flowing profusely?

Di Quan: That is the original spirit tree of sentient beings. Recently, when they entered the holy gate, they diligently participated in the descent, so the tree was lush and bore many fruits, but because the blood energy was too strong, the wine energy rushed up, so the tree's leaves turned green. But because they still took wrong steps, they had to go to the hospital today for treatment, so their original spirit was also damaged. I hope that sentient beings will soon become enlightened so that in this life the big tree will not fall, so that from death they can find a way to live, truly relying on the quiet help of the gods. Don't blame heaven and blame others. Heaven has mercy on sentient beings. Absolutely no intention of harming people. It's all about cause and effect. Cultivate quickly and rebuild new roots.

Duong Sinh: The strength of this tree is very fast and strong, but its branches are crooked and not straight, the reason is unknown?

Dijun: This is the primordial tree of sentient beings, its strength is strong, so it is not straight, the tree uses uprightness as good, the branches are like human hands, although it is multi-functional, it must be shared and many fruits are lost. Blessings are shared with others, but we don't get anything. If the tree's branches are straight, our children and grandchildren will enjoy infinite happiness.

Duong Sinh: Dear sir, why does this tree have no leaves but has so many branches like the thousand arms of Avalokiteshvara?

De Quan: This is the original spirit tree of sentient beings, it has a trunk but no leaves, and too many branches. like the thousand arms of Avalokiteshvara changing infinitely. Therefore, all four directions enjoy the grace of rain and rain, just like a businessman who does not have capital but still prospers, so having many branches and no leaves is like a person without clothes, fearing that at some point, the body will be damaged, making it difficult to protect itself. Hopefully that tree will soon grow green leaves to provide shade in the future.

Duong Sinh: That Nguyen Linh tree has grown slowly, the leaves are still sparse, why does it seem to be withered?

Di Quan: That is a symptom of malnutrition, this is also the original spirit tree of living beings, although it freely floats, but because it has been away from the shining light and the water of Dharma for a long time, it seems weak. I hope to receive help from the Immortals everywhere to restore the vital energy.

Duong Sinh: That primordial tree grows green and bears too much fruit, I don't know why?

De Quan: That is the primordial tree of the kind of sentient beings that, since entering the holy gate, has only been good in one aspect of reciting scriptures, the yellow leaves show that the roots are old, and the branches are old. half of it withers because the karma is too heavy. I hope that tree can restore its vitality, get rid of all worries, and devote effort to cultivate the mind and improve its nature, otherwise it will not be able to reach heaven.

Duong Sinh: That tree is barren, but its vitality is strong and it also bears fruit, why?

Di Quan: That is the path tree of sentient beings, from the time they entered the holy gate until now, they have specialized in studying the truth, being humiliated without complaining, the spirit of progress is truly persistent, if we continue to try, not give up halfway, surely the path can be achieved in the future.

Duong Sinh: This primordial spirit tree has a sign with the name of the disciple, in the future. What will become of the disciples?

Di Quan: The roots of Duong Sinh's Dharma tree are deep, the leaves are many, and it is currently lush, proving that many achievements in Dharma and fruition have been achieved. If I wholeheartedly dedicate myself to changing the teachings of heaven

to transform, I only have the blessing: "Immeasurable merit."

Revelation to the Buddha: Today Time is tight, the poor monk is about to guide Duong Sinh back to Thanh Hien Duong. I hope that another day I will have the opportunity to return to ask for further instructions.

Duong Sinh: Today, I would like to thank His Holiness the Emperor for putting in so much effort in teaching me, and I take my leave.

Di Quan: I respectfully send you both back to Thanh Hien Hall.

Buddhist worship: Having arrived at the Sage Hall, Duong Sinh got down on the lotus, his soul entered his body.

THE WORDS HE TEACHED

(1) We practice in noisy places, in the market. We who practice in the world must see that everything is us, we are everything, then we can see "joy in heaven".

tieu_de: Chapter 15: Strolling the Donghua Palace for the Fourth Time to Visit the Tree of the Spirit of Living Beings
noi_dung:
PART FIFTEEN

TOURING THE FOURTH TIME OF THE FOURTH PALACE

VISITING THE PRINCIPAL TREE OF BEINGS

Living Buddha Te Gong Christmas, November 16, Year of the Goat (1979)

Poetry

The natural way of heaven is the source of love for life
High feet in the four lands of Tien Minh
Digging the natural beauty of the landscape
The jade tree, golden flower, devoted to glory.

Translation

Originally, the way of heaven is very fond of living beings
Holy fairies everywhere are full of light
The scenery is so bright
Jade trees and yellow flowers are all beautiful.

Buddha worship: Although saving sentient beings is the Buddha's work, it is actually the sentient beings' own work, because only sentient beings who save sentient beings can attain enlightenment. If Saint Hien Duong finished writing the book Heavenly Journey but sentient beings did not develop the heart and diligently read it, then Immortals and Buddhas would not be able to do anything more. Therefore, from ancient times until now, people who practice Buddhism have relied on themselves. If people can enlighten to the truth and practice, the path to paradise is right before their eyes. They do not need the guidance of Immortals and Buddhas. They can naturally return to their roots in the old village and countryside. On the contrary, if the Immortals and Buddhas reluctantly take sentient beings to heaven, the sentient beings in this place are not used to it, and within a few days they will be destroyed, with no trace left to be found. Therefore, those who practice religion in this world must know clearly about life in heaven, practice liberality, let go of all attachments, and eliminate all afflictions. If they can practice like this, then when they go to heaven, they will be able to adapt to the situation, no longer feel that living in heaven is more miserable than the world, and then even if they want to return to the world, they will not be able to, there is only one way to be reincarnated in another life.Therefore, the poor monk hopes that sentient beings must first open their minds, and those who practice religion must not discriminate against other religions. If they disobey their words, when they reach heaven, the Gods and their enlightened believers in heaven will come looking for them. When I realized my previous mistakes, it was too late, because that attack had already caused my spirituality to be depressed and lost. Therefore, in this world, you need to make many good relationships. When you get to heaven, you will be relieved of difficulties when you go to heaven. People who practice religion need to live in harmony, be happy with religion, and cultivate the virtue of love for life and friendliness. Only those who possess these virtues will be sublime and enter the Sainthood. When you are not despised in this world, then in heaven there will definitely be a place reserved for you. Today is the time to walk to paradise, Duong Sinh quickly climbs to the lotus platform so that he and his teacher can visit Dong Hoa palace again.

Duong Sinh: Dear son, I am ready, I respectfully invite you to leave.

Buddhist worship: Having arrived at Dong Hoa palace, let us quickly go and bow to meet the Emperor.

Duong Sinh: Obeying orders... Master Te Buddha and his disciples would like to bow to the Emperor Donghua, today he has come to bother you again, I respectfully ask for your forgiveness.

Dijun: Without paying any respects, Donghua's scenic spots have been revealed on earth, hoping that people will respond to going to heaven. Last time, I guided Duong Thien Sinh to visit the elemental spirits of trees and flowers. If there are any places that I haven't been to yet, today I will guide Duong Sinh to visit again.

Duong Sinh: Thank you for the great virtue of Emperor Quan, who spared no effort in guiding and explaining the reasons for the elemental spirits of trees and flowers to the disciples... Having arrived at the garden, the branches and leaves are lush, the flowers are blooming in all colors happily, to be seen. This scene is extremely peaceful and gentle.

Di Quan: However, these trees are not completely the same, because all species are endowed with a different life, like flowers and grass in the field, we see that each species has its own way of life.

Duong Sinh: The original spirit of these trees is medium-sized so it is very sturdy and bears many fruits. I don't know the reason why?

Di Quan: This is the path tree of sentient beings. From the moment they entered the Holy Door until now, they have been taking care of their merits, when they sit in unison, they speak loudly, and their character is upright and strong, so their path trees have lush branches and leaves, and bear many fruits. Recently, they have suffered a lot of hardships and frosts, so they are extremely tired. I hope they will not be discouraged and maintain their ambition to promote morality. Wealth in the world can only be obtained by those who are predestined. Therefore, religion also requires a lot of cultivation to be able to achieve it.

Duong Sinh: This original spirit tree is really tall, the leaves grow a lot, but the fruit is few and not yet ripe, I'm not sure what the future will be like?

Dijun: This is the path of sentient beings. These sentient beings have good roots so they have a peaceful temperament. From the time they entered the Holy Door until now, they have taken care to cultivate their minds and improve their character. Although we have not yet achieved great results, we have clearly recognized the truth to try to follow, diligently listen to teachings about morality, and the future results of morality must be immeasurable.

Duong Sinh: This is a medium-sized primordial tree with many branches and leaves, but the leaves have black spots. It has just bloomed but has not yet produced fruit, the reason is unclear?

Di Quan: This is the tree of the path of sentient beings, from the time they entered the Holy Door until now, although they have the heart to practice the religion, the impurities from the past have not been washed away, and so sometimes they still commit the same mistakes again. previous sins were so severe that the path was dark. I hope that you will not be discouraged and neglect yourself. If you strive to improve, it will eventually bear fruit, and your future path will certainly be bright. God does not disappoint those who have a wish. Duong Thien Sinh, please observe those flowers carefully.

Duong Sinh: Yes, I will carefully examine these plants to reveal some of the fundamentals for female Dharma companions to clearly understand. These trees bloom and bear fruit in a strange way, like Ganoderma grass, the reason is unknown?

Dijun: This is the path of sentient beings. From the time they entered the Holy Door until now, sentient beings have devoted themselves to meritorious deeds, secretly cultivating the path, fasting to purify their bodies, persevering in their determination, patiently enduring when faced with trials by demons, absolutely loyal to the Holy Emperor, and cultivating their will to become more and more steadfast. The results of cultivating this path reach the top level of the fairy grass "Lingzhi", I hope that those female Dharma friends continue to practice like this forever, and will definitely achieve righteous results.

Duong Sinh: That flower tree blooms extremely magnificently, the branches and leaves are extremely lush, but the disciples still do not know the reason?

Di Quan: That is The flower of the path of sentient beings, the lush appearance of the flower is because this friend of the path is enthusiastic about his work and results, and cares about studying the path, so he has realized the truth, his mind is not attached to opinions or leaning to one side or the other. He can be considered a person who has developed wisdom. That's why the flower of the path blooms strongly, bears fruit on all branches. If you try to practice continuously, you can surely attain enlightenment.

Duong Sinh: That tree is tall, the flowers bloom a lot, but they fall a lot, I don't know why?

Dijun: This is the flower path of sentient beings, from the time they entered the Holy Door until now, they have devoted their hearts to the path but are flawed, like the pistil of a flower that refuses to stay in the flower, which means the mind is scattered. I hope that those female Dharma friends can regain their minds of extroversion, cultivating the Dharma only needs one point to be sincere, but otherwise they keep doing useless things like listening to the winter wind with their horse's ears, casting bait to catch the shadow, they must have worked a lot but still in vain.

Duong Sinh: This type of flower tree grows well, bears a lot of fruit but is not yet ripe, the reason is unknown?

Desire Quan: This is the flower path of sentient beings. From the time they entered the Holy Door until now, they have diligently studied the path of transcendent wisdom, deep good roots, and the fruits are still green and unripe. I hope that they will strive to practice further.

Duong Sinh: That type of flower tree stands alone on one side, looking weak and debilitated, not sure why?

Di Quan: That is the flower path of sentient beings. Since entering the Holy Door, these sentient beings have had the heart to cultivate the path, but because their marriage has failed and they live a lonely life, they know how to take care of themselves. That is the cause and effect of their previous lives. Don't be discouraged. You must try to understand the truth. Cultivate the path and practice meditation. The light will naturally reflect back.

Yang Sinh: This tree The flowers are very beautiful, but the branches are broken, I don't know why?

Di Quan: This is the flower path of sentient beings, ordinary beings have just enough wisdom, but the flower path is too much, so the flowers and branches are scattered. If we maintain the foundation and take care of repair, it will be as beautiful as a flower in a vase, it can become a willow branch in the Calm Water vase to hold the nectar that Avalokiteshvara often sprinkles. save sentient beings.

Duong Sinh: I see that the original spirit tree is growing tall, with lush branches and leaves, and many flowers and fruits, I don't know why?

Di Quan: That is the primordial spirit tree of the sentient beings who has made great contributions to the Saint Sage. It can be said to be one with the Elder, usually secretly practicing by himself, so he has achieved quite a lot of merit, and hopes to practice more diligently to achieve enlightenment.

Duong Sinh: This middle-level primordial spirit tree has good leaves but the fruit is still green, the reason is unknown. what?

Dijun: This path of sentient beings, from the time they entered the Holy Door until now, has endured hardships and received official duties, so they have accumulated many meritorious fruits, but they are still green and not yet ripe, hopefully they will try to practice further. Today, when I went to see the primordial plants here, I already understood quite a lot. If there are any remaining primordial spirits that have not yet been released, I will continue to report more on another day. The things just mentioned above are only temporarily providing a few documents for sentient beings to refer to. The success or failure of cultivating the Dharma depends entirely on each individual. Good people who do not practice will surely fall, bad people who try to practice will surely achieve righteous results. Just like planting a tree, just by looking at the garden you can see the results in advance. I hope that all sentient beings cultivating the path will not be discouraged. If they are disappointed, they will not be able to take care of the plants in the garden. The weeds will grow all over and the plants will wither, proving that the roots of the path have been weakened and they will not be able to achieve righteous results in the future.

Yang Sinh: The Emperor, because of his mission of salvation, has bestowed a lot of love on sentient beings. His merit in taking care of the souls of living beings is truly deep and extensive. suffering.

Di Quan: All things and I are of the same body, every breath is related, joy and worry are shared, flowers breathe out good air for humanity to absorb, humanity breathes out fresh air for plants to inhale, all kinds of life on earth, the need to help each other is so necessary, creation is miraculous but the mutual help of all things is inconceivable. If we say that we look out for sentient beings, it is like saying that sentient beings pray for many blessings. Although heaven and earth do not speak, looking at each person's face, we can know the mentality, each changing phenomenon does not have language to express. Looking at flowers blooming means spring has come, leaves falling means autumn has come, mute people cannot speak but can use their hands to express what they want to say, so the mind surpasses words. The changing wind, rain, thunder, and lightning of the planet, that is also the desire of heaven to demonstrate to living beings so that the wise can know the temperament of people, so that cultivators can clearly understand the changes of heaven and earth and act back and forth without deviation. The above mentioned things must have opened the minds and helped the souls of sentient beings move towards the ideal peaceful paradise.Now, to demonstrate the truth, I guide Duong Sinh to visit the original spirit of the sentient beings who have returned to live in their origin.

Duong Sinh: Thank you for the compassion of Moc Cong, the sentient beings under the sky are very blessed to hear your sermon, they will certainly shout with joy, be grateful, believe and follow, the great religion is in the same body, it is an extremely practical truth.

Dijun: Heaven is the parents, people are children incarnated by god, understanding people means understanding heaven, the heavenly father always wants the children under his feet to be happy, if unfortunately the child commits a crime and is banished to hell to be punished, when he returns, the parents will happily hold a banquet to purify and rescue him. Therefore, people should not make the mistake of thinking that heaven is too far away. If there is a criminal who only needs to change, a new life will sprout and grow strong, and heaven will also welcome him. Although there are many sentient beings under the sky who sincerely cultivate the Way, the situation after attaining enlightenment is all vaguely understood, or blindly understood. Today I will express the situation so that sentient beings can understand it clearly. Duong Sinh, please follow me.

Duong Sinh: Following the Emperor, he felt that the burden was heavy and the road was far, with the Holy Spirit behind him chasing after him. noi_dung:
PART TWENTY-SIX

COURTING THE GREAT HOUSE TO WEAR THE SAINTS OF THE MASTER

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas Day, June 13, Year of the Monkey (1980)

Poetry

Cultural renaissance and red grapes
Gonorrhea o live virtuously
Correct four concubines become saints
The sin of destroying all thoughts of Namo.

Translation

Cultural revival of homesickness for Confucianism
A poor life with no worries
The four virtues of preserving sincerity and holiness
Should one recite namo for sins to be eliminated.

Buddhist worship: Currently, the popular education industry is very widespread, children are taken early to kindergartens to open their minds, then continue to elementary school, high school, university and study abroad. It can be said that most children today go to school and will all be brilliant and talented scholars in the future. But the words in books are spoken out loud, written in writing, purely for the sake of fame and fortune, but when it comes to helping life and saving people, people stay away in fear. The teachings in the books of the ancient saints and sages, all of which use question and answer techniques, are used to avoid imitation and turning into parrots reading books. There are also many people who read more books, their cunning minds become more sophisticated and skillful, those who master the law and their criminal techniques become more sophisticated. Reading books is to improve their morality, but instead they turn it into a means to earn a lot of money, which makes the old monk's heart endlessly sad. I hope people should replace books of study with moral sutras. Don't study for profit. Reading books to learn is only meant to expand knowledge and improve human qualities. If it becomes a tool to make a living, it means turning books into paper money. That money is really not valuable money.If you use intelligence in plotting crimes, you will definitely become a terribly depraved intellectual. Today, the teacher guided Duong Sinh to visit the heavenly landscapes. Prepare to go to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Dear, I have finished preparing. We cordially invite you to set out.

Buddhist worship: Teacher and student sit on a lotus flower, ride the wind, push the clouds, and fly straight to the pure heaven. The worldly world gradually disappeared behind us and lost all traces... Arrived.

Duong Sinh: When we came to this place today, the scene was completely different from last time, shadows of writers appeared everywhere, their postures were completely sublime, some were strolling and reciting poetry...

Buddhist worship: The scene we visited today was the scene of a grape village, ahead. is Dai Thanh Palace, let's quickly go to the front to bow and greet His Holiness Confucius.

Duong Sinh: Very good, very good. What an honor it is to be able to visit the holy scene of Confucius' door today, looking at the glorious garden of the Hanh Dan garden, I see that it is truly not false.

at all, in front of the main hall there are three words: "Dai Thanh Palace" on all sides pure and not contaminated with a speck of dust, on both sides the costumes look like scholars and scholars, expressing their welcome to us. Following the master, entering the hall, I saw an elderly man sitting in the middle of the hall, and on both sides there were disciples sitting as servants. The decoration in the hall seemed ancient, ink and brush pens neatly displayed, precious books in countless chests, the elderly man sitting in the middle of the hall was Confucius.

Buddhist worship: The one sitting in the middle was the Supreme Saint of the Confucian village, his name was Confucius, sitting on both sides were the monks. Your saintly disciple, Duong Sinh, quickly bowed before the Master.

Duong Sinh: Please obey. I would like to bow my head and bow to the Holy One and all the saints. I hope that you will break my ignorance to open my mind.

Confucius: The Confucian Village is very honored, because Duong Sinh admires Confucianism, so he personally opened the altar named Hanh Dan, used the Holy pen to write the holy scriptures to awaken people. I am in the sacred heaven, my heart feels comforted3. Although the Confucian village does not mention strange myths, the virtue of demons and gods pervades the eternal universe, so I have no objections, but I think how can people who do not know how to live know how to die? I am afraid that they will abandon their roots and run after their roots, despise the present life, and value the life in the other world, so I advise my disciples that anything related to ghosts and gods should not be discussed. The "middle" path, which means tolerance and generosity, is the virtue of compassion, keeping one's self and following the path of benevolence, one's human nature is compatible with the nature of heaven, although one does not speak of heaven, one can attain the heavenly way, living

NOTE 3

comfort: consolation

natural death is in my control, so it is said: "Listen to the teachings in the morning, and die in the evening" (Trieu van dao, death is possible). If a person lives carefreely, does not betray human morality, and maintains the three diamonds and five principles, he is in accordance with the great morality. When he lives to keep the morality, after death he will definitely return to a good land. Looking back at today's grape village, those who teach and those who learn all focus on diplomas to make a living, leading to the deterioration of moral qualities. Because

despise learning to cultivate oneself, people say: "If you study a lot, you will lie a lot, but stupid people will be upright." I hope that when people read books, in addition to cultivating knowledge, they must also pay attention to cultivating morality. Otherwise, the more they study, the more they will cheat, their reputation will be destroyed, and many evils will arise in society to prove that those who use cunning schemes in this world will be treated cunningly in return when they return to heaven.

Duong Sinh: Duc Phu Tu truly deserves the title of "Van The Master Bieu" which means the eternal teacher, Confucian students in the world forever embrace the teachings "Virtue is the same as heaven and earth, the way is throughout ancient times" (Duc combines heaven and earth, Tao is ancient and modern) one word of praise is not enough, Phu Tu's teachings are like golden pearls, disciples please remember forever. I respectfully request that the Venerable Phu Tu teach Confucian disciples clearly how to cultivate the Dharma? And then what will be the result? To be like the monks and Confucian immortals today who are enjoying the blessings of heaven, free and easy, the disciples admire it very much, but they don't know how to practice?

Confucius: Today's Confucian students study only for exams, so working hard day and night is very useless, just trying to cram in as many words and meanings as possible, but in the daily ritual of dealing with people and things, one can clearly see their disobedience, so people often criticize them as "studying but not practicing". If anyone in the intellectual world falls into this situation, please think quickly. As soon as you leave school and enter social life, you should apply the teachings of the saints and sages in the scriptures to life, to always be gentle, respectful, humble, and stay away from the four "no's" which are: if you are not polite, don't look, if you are not polite, don't listen, if you are not polite, don't speak, if you aren't polite, don't do. Three times a day, I remind myself to cultivate myself and nourish my character, even though I did not become a monk to seek the Dharma, but actually practiced the Dharma, worked in society with integrity and was not corrupt, that is the way intellectuals repay the country. In addition, we must treat everyone equally to convert them. To do so, Heaven will soon reserve a position for us. One day, I will leave this life and come to this good land to live freely, no longer subject to the suffering of reincarnation.

Duong Sinh: It turns out that the origin is like that, the Confucian cultivators only need to keep the four "no's" to avoid committing sins, which is no different from Buddhism, and cultivating the religion right in the middle of life is indeed realistic.

Buddhist worship: Each individual must awaken to the four "no's" to become a righteous man, to preserve the noble person inside him or her. Ordinary people are accustomed to calling them saints and sages, as well as being called Immortals and Buddhas, concerned with helping the world and benefiting others, their spirituality and the heavens becoming one. The reason why today I am a Saint and Philosopher in this heaven is because in the past I have made a career of plotting for the welfare of the world.

Duong Sinh: Dear Venerable Master, your disciples standing on both sides, can you tell us about their life in heaven?

Fu Tzu: Maybe, because my disciples are dedicated to learning the Dharma, their hearts are one with mine, determined to practice my Dharma, therefore they can gather together here today, that is not a coincidence. I have four Taoists, ten philosophers, seventy-two sages and three thousand disciples, along with countless people learning the religion whose names I do not know. Those who follow my teachings will all be reunited in heaven. Confucianism does not restrict rituals like other religions. It does not believe in mysticism. If you deeply understand my religion, you must cultivate yourself with your heart and follow the rituals. It can be said that talented people and their spirituality can naturally transcend the mortal world and reach the holy world. Let's take the example of Nhan Hoi, the saint, to say, in a poor place, eating rice and vegetables and drinking water, if people don't stop worrying, they won't be happy. In today's world, who can lead a noble life and maintain their Confucian identity to become such a gentleman? Does anyone consider wealth as floating clouds?Among the disciples, there are many people who, when they were still alive, had the style of being rich and not lustful, poor and not submissive, not using precepts like religion but still keeping the precepts, considering competition as light as thin ice. While living, he had such a demeanor. After death, he naturally escaped the bondage of the mortal world and attained enlightenment to become a Saint and Immortal.

Duong Sinh: The saints of ancient times practiced the Dharma like that, what about the saints of today?

Phu Tu: There are many modern saints and sages who have attained the status of saints, like some Confucian scholars outside the palace, not only fulfilling their current duties as an educator but also fulfilling the mission of a moralist because throughout his life he used his heart to open up the religion to his students, not being greedy for enjoyment, although his body was hungry and cold, his mind was pure, day and night he was concerned with fulfilling his responsibilities, morality filled the world, the Hanh Dan was fragrant. After they passed away, they all went to heaven to live freely and freely. Therefore, we hope that educators in the world today must take care to cultivate their minds to educate people. Before teaching, they must prepare a strong moral spirit to propagate to their students. They must not commit unscrupulous crimes that will harm the future of children. Don't be greedy to open your own classes to make money, considering the main teaching hours at school as extra, because doing so is not having a sense of responsibility, invisibly destroying your spirituality, and in the future you will be tormented and extremely miserable. This land is full of peach trees, and each professor's achievements can be known from there.People who are dedicated to their positions and have noble qualities will fill the garden with peach trees and have a sweet scent. On the contrary, peach trees will lose all their leaves and cannot bear fruit. Unfortunately, according to the concept of today's people, this issue does not need to be mentioned. Those who have a moral conscience should keep it as their own. Besides, just taking care of normal responsibilities is enough.

Buddhist worship: The teachers in the world are all saints and sages incarnated to be eternal teachers, the spring wind turns into rain, and the students are grateful forever. Don't be a teacher who lacks conscience and harms the future of his students. Because it's getting late, I'd like to say goodbye to Lord Phu Tu.

Puppet: Since I can't stay any longer, I pray that the canonization of sainthood will be ever more glorious.

Duong Sinh: Thank you Lord Phu Tu for giving me the golden teachings... I've finished preparing, I respectfully invite you to return to the Holy Sage Hall.

Buddhist worship: Having arrived at the Holy Sage Hall, Duong Sinh got down on the lotus and his soul entered his body.

tieu_de: Chapter 27: Walking through the Dai Hung Tay Thien Bao Palace to worship the Śākyamuni Buddha Association

PART TWENTY-SEVEN

DAI HUNG TAY THIEN DIAMOND PALACE

SHAKEMAMUNI BUDDHA CONFERENCE

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas day, June 29, year of Canh Than (1980)

Poetry

Buddhist dharma of the West, one free and self-emptying
Complete with the mind and intention, practice
The eye stores the dharma of the flower seal laugh
Sea of suffering from foolish vulgar goods.

Translation

Buddhism comes here with one word “no”
All thanks to determined effort
Holding flowers and smiling to spread the true dharma
The sea of suffering is a boat from saving the foolish.

Buddha worship: Buddhism from the West came to save many ignorant sentient beings, thanks to which the Chinese people's character became pure, the meaning of Buddhist teachings for life was achieved without planning in advance, this tradition absorbed foreign religions, then merged and expanded widely, so that land at one time became the world's spiritual and religious center. Nowadays, many people practice Buddhism. They spread the teachings of compassion very generously to help the world and benefit others. For the world's spiritual people, there are too many benefits. Coming from a line of saintly monks at the Buddha's door, I was also a monk, an Arhat incarnated, then left my small house and went to every house of sentient beings to practice karma, so I became a monk for the sake of sentient beings. There are some people who have become monks but hide in temples and pagodas, not meeting sentient beings. They have returned from big houses, society, to small houses, pagodas and temples. Imprisoning oneself is considered a lonely person, unable to become a Buddha of all people, what a pity. Today, the old monk will guide Duong Sinh to the Western heaven, worship the World-Honored One and respectfully listen to his sermon.

Duong Sinh: My son, I have finished preparing, I respectfully invite you to go on your way.

Buddhist worship: ...The Dai Hung Palace has appeared before our eyes, let us quickly go and bow before the World-Honored One.

Duong Sinh: Dai Hung Palace is truly majestic, like a temple. Great temple in the world, there are many monks and nuns wearing saffron robes walking back and forth, including small novice monks, this scene is truly a wonderful picture, all of them are bowing to us.

Buddhist worship: This is the Buddha country of the western sky, completely quiet without a speck of dust.

Duong Sinh: Precious stones and lapis lazuli filled the ground with shimmering radiance, the climate was calm, the scent of the religion was fragrant... The World-Honored One sat in the middle, his appearance was solemn, his whole body was shining brightly, on both sides were two powerful Vedic guardians, making people feel the divine presence, not daring to intrude... The disciples kowtowed in honor of the World-Honored One, today the disciples following the teacher to visit the Three Jewels Palace, with great joy in my heart, I respectfully asked the World-Honored One to open the Buddha Dharma.

World-Honored One: Yang Sheng, please stand up. The Buddha Dharma has been widely spread throughout the East, throughout the ages it has not deteriorated, and the wisdom that exists forever is due to the efforts of Buddhists to sacrifice their lives to protect the Dharma. I am very moved. Nowadays, when the Dharma ends, all religions are thriving. Buddhism in particular has spread throughout the world. More and more scholars have taken refuge in Buddhism to practice. It is enough to know how much Buddhism helps sentient beings. Everyone who takes refuge in Buddha must keep the precepts, never get bored throughout their lives, and practice until they reach clear mind and see their nature to attain enlightenment. Duong Sinh is a messenger from the holy gate. He is also sincere in his practice and practice of Buddhism. He is truly a kind-hearted intellectual. Thanh Hien Duong spreads the sage truth that is very consistent with Buddhism, because "don't do evil deeds, do good deeds" (evil beings act, good people obey). It can be said that it is the righteous Dharma in the Dharma-Ending Age, the Tathagata appears at the holy door to save sentient beings, open the Dharma method, cultivate immeasurable merit, everyone should learn it.

World-Honored One: Buddhists are facing the end of the dharma, disciples have left Buddha too far away, living beings today have good roots but lack wisdom roots, they study Buddhism and practice the way, they read few sutras and refuse to consult and research extensively. Only studying Buddhism, but in addition, the scriptures of other religions are not paid attention to, or interpreted in a subjective way, creating bias, not considering other religions as "friend religions", then cursing and pen criticizing other religions as pagans and heretics, Buddha's mouth spits blood, butcher's knife kills, I am so heartbroken. Buddha has forty-eight thousand dharma methods, the Sage Hall worships the Immortals and Buddhas, the ancient sages are very compatible with the Buddha's mind, the clear mind accepts the precepts, recites sutras and mantras, sincerely prays for the holy spirits of the upper world to descend to earth, fragrant clouds immediately come, the Buddhas and tranquil Bodhisattvas are inspired by their sincerity, come to preach the Dharma and teach the way, and have the predestined conditions to open and guide them to overcome their delusions. If good men and women follow the five precepts, try their best to practice goodness, and recite Buddha's name wholeheartedly, Buddha will surely come and respond, Buddha's power protects the writing, wonderful pens give birth to flowers, and preaches the Dharma to save them. It is indeed reasonable and easy to practice. I hope Buddhists will not despise other Buddhas and destroy their own wisdom.Because the eyes and wisdom of sentient beings are clouded, they only read paper sutras, and their ears only listen to people speaking before uttering slanderous words. The light of the path shines, the sacred pen is moved to write words, if I could see it, I would definitely "have a sentient stage of communication" that is, if I have feelings, I can understand, reciting Buddha's name, but if I don't believe in Buddha, but chant sutras and mantras early in the day, wouldn't it turn out to be a pagan? The world worships justice, all religions as long as they do not betray good customs, and are beneficial to the world, are righteous. Buddha is revered by the world because he taught sentient beings with compassion and equality, considering all sentient beings as one, the four species of sentient beings, the six paths of reincarnation are all three generations of relatives, all have the same Buddha nature, are also Buddha's body. If one despises fellow human beings, it is called studying Buddha but opposing Buddha, it is unclear what the Buddha's high view is?

World-Honored One: Buddhism embraces everything, that's why it is said that Buddhism is boundless, paganism is like an outer robe, a practitioner must wear it to protect the Buddha's body, so why should they throw it away or destroy it? Sentient beings on the vast earth, each individual has their own vocation, respects the Buddha, and lives the Buddha's life, do they still harbor the urge to trample and trample? All those who oppose religion and attack others are driven by separate minds, jealous hearts, anger and ignorance that have not yet been destroyed, Buddha's mouth spits fire, and kills countless people who are no different from butchers. The fresh flowers and sweet fruits offered to the Buddha must have been cultivated by the hard-working pagans and cultivated by the hands of pagans. Would the Buddha reject them? Or the Buddha was moved to generate compassion. Who provides the monks and nuns with clothing, shelter, and transportation at the Buddha's door? Who manufactured? I hope the monks and nuns at Buddha's door will quickly throw away their butcher knives and not kill their good and virtuous friends, so as not to be indefinitely damned and suffer endless retribution.

Duong Sinh: The merits of the World-Honored One are immeasurable, the Tathagata is great in justice, his soul is boundless, he saves all sentient beings, he preaches the Dharma without bias, only to help the minds of sentient beings to open, the disciples would like to pay homage to him.

World-Honored One: I have the Dharma eye treasure that is passed down to the world, forever like a diamond that cannot be destroyed, whoever is enlightened will be successful. Buddha.

Yang Sinh: Sir, is that the Dharma "Nirvana wonderful mind"?

World-Honored One: Yes. The true form is formless, seen right before your eyes.

Yang Sinh: That means seeing the Buddha right in front of you, looking back you can't see it.

World-Honored One: Born in this Buddha land, there are Buddhas everywhere, leave this Buddha land, see yourself as a Buddha, if you don't see it, if you look in the mirror, you will definitely see it, confirm that you and the Buddha are one, "mind form." "reflected form", if you don't leave your mind, you will naturally become a Buddha.

Duong Sinh: Yes, yes. Why do you see a red bead in front of the Buddha's forehead?

World-Honored One: It is born, it is not lost, it goes back and forth alone, it does not open or close, that is the Buddha's eyes. Using that eye to look at things will not be biased, looking at yourself will be righteous and not tilted left or right, only one, the bright light on Linh Son mountain, thanks to that you can clear your mind and see your nature, go straight to Tathagata's land, so it is said that the Dharma eye treasury is so wonderful that it cannot be described in words. (1)

Buddhist worship: That eye can see through the three thousand great thousand worlds, as big as Mount Meru, small as a grain of sand, so

it should be said: "When it is radiant, it overwhelms the whole universe, when it is collected, it retreats into the secret place".

Duong Sinh: Venerable monks and nuns who have become monks and nuns There is a mark of precepts on the top of the head, meaning why?

World-Honored One: Burning scars have a scent that highlights Buddha nature. The monks and nuns have burning incense marks on their heads, meaning that flowers have bloomed on the top of their skulls, that head is indeed the Buddha's head, the bud must be full to form the fruit of Paramita. If the person receiving the precepts betrays the righteous path, the precepts will not be able to give birth to a Bodhi tree. Invisibly, the roots of evil will grow, and the head will turn into a demon's head, so the Western Buddha country will be difficult to approach.

Duong Sinh: So that's the origin. Buddha winks, says a word, does a word, it is all Buddha's Dharma, it cannot be thought about. I would like to ask the World-Honored One, if there are people who practice Buddhism now, what must they do to attain enlightenment?

World-Honored One: If you want to be a legitimate disciple at the Buddha's door, of course the method of practice must be followed as follows:

1. Faith: Believing that Buddha is true, believing that you are not fake, believing that others are not strange, the three beliefs combine to form one general truth. believe to be saved, those who believe become Buddhas.

2. Solution: To understand the Buddha Dharma, don't be blinded by the words and meanings. If you want to interpret the sutras, you must first liberate the mind. If you only interpret the literature, words and meanings in the sutras, without understanding the root of the mind, it is like locking your precious body into a prison. If you are a prisoner, how can you be liberated to become a Buddha? Only by eliminating the three poisons of greed, anger, and ignorance will the body and mind be calm and enter the land of Buddha.

3. Practice: Clearly understand "faith, resolve" but if you do not practice, it is considered as nothing, cultivating the path is precious in practice, that's why we say "practice". Practitioners need to have a noble and pedagogical demeanor, because "if a practitioner walks alone, the path he or she practices is only a small path, but the path that many people practice with is the big path." Therefore, the practitioner who goes alone is to save the sentient beings who accompany him. Only then can he comply with the teachings of the path of compassion: "not being an individual hero".

4. Testimony: Buddha has eighty-four thousand dharma methods, anyone who is sincere and persistent in cultivating can attain enlightenment, anyone who practices will have experience, Zen monks and lay practitioners who practice will have real realization. The same goes for other religions and dharmas, if you practice them, you will attain it. Don't give rise to discrimination, anger, and defamation, then self-burn and bury your own nature, merit, and destroy your wisdom roots. It's like a tree hitting "people walking", leaves falling and fruit falling, just because

wants to harm others, they will harm you, so it is said: "If you use fire to burn the sky, you will burn yourself", you must remember that carefully.

Buddhist Worship: In the world, many people worship Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara, because his peaceful dharma form is like a gentle mother in a family, so people love and be close to him, so he is also honored as the one who hears the cries of every family, as Elder Mother Avalokiteśvara, bowing to Avalokiteshvara is like bowing to an old mother. Therefore, it is also called "Avalokitesvara Ancient Buddha" or "South Sea Ancient Buddha". He heard the cries of suffering and saved suffering. SEARCH TWENTY-NINE

TEACHING THE WORLD OF WESTERN EXTREME Dharma

LISTENING TO THE BUDDHA Amitabha SPEAKING THE Dharma

Living Buddha Ji Cong Christmas on the 26th day of the 7th month, year of Canh Than (1980)

Poetry

Hellless and blissful, the most contemptible body
The still land needs to be nourished and cultivated

Thien Bien Hai Enlightenment to travel.

Translation

Escape from worldly life happily and gently change the body
Good land to cultivate and live a spacious life
Full of merit to worship Buddha
The sea is wide and the sky is high.

Buddhist Worship: Everywhere we hear of people studying Buddhism and cultivating the Way, but in the end, if we want to study Buddhism and practice the Way, what should we do? As far as the old monk sees it, there is nothing, just ask your heart, if you see that your heart is not ashamed, I think you are close to Buddha. Being away from the mind means there is no Buddha to find, just like in a temple there is not a single thing, it cannot be called a temple, in the human body if there is no mind, how can one be human. Therefore, may all sentient beings try to become mindful people. The mind can change infinitely, like a good costume designer who can draw hundreds, thousands of different strange outfits. The human mind can be compared to an expert in designing clothes, who can change the appearance of his body into many different looks, whether he wants to turn into a Buddha or a devil, depending on his mind. Each individual is a magic master, he can do it any way he wants, go any way he wants, make him laugh any way he wants. The old monk only hopes to become a good person, to become a God, a Saint, an Immortal, and not to turn himself into a demon or devil to make people afraid or hate him.
